shared_elements: incised linear signs/characters on a flat stone surface
script-like symbols arranged in registers or panels
justification: Both surfaces bear incised, non-pictorial linear signs on a flat face, and both organise marks with framing or ruled lines, but that is a generic correspondence. A shows dense horizontal rows of small script covering the whole wall, while B shows a single large central figurative/emblematic device (a boxed motif flanked by curling volute-like shapes) inside a wide banded border with small cartouche-like panels at the edges — a completely different compositional scheme and repertoire.
